label: try T56, a labelled in-sample diagnostic, never an adoption result: M1 (with R1, R2 and g_mom's factors, the entry's form) with its Feng step along the common part of Feng's direction alone at the entry's squared size (try T55's cn form), at the step and twice the step, against the entry's step of the same fraction, in the worlds of tries T50 (library 3's truth as released and thinned to two thirds and a third, two draws at a third) and T54 (the reference thinned to two thirds, two draws, and a half) on the chamber cut; the result can only go to the team captain, and no outcome is evidence on Task 1's read depth, which stays closed
choices: b0, m1_r_gmom and m1_r_gmom_x2 are built on the entry's directions as tries T50 and T54 load them (feng_dirs.feng_directions); the forms on the entry's directions as try T55 loads them (share_read.feng_inputs, feng_dirs.directions_from_stats); the run records per group, over every group either route gives, whether the two agree by sha256, and the read voids a world whose record is missing, empty or not all true (amendment).

The forms are built only for the three arms the brief names (c1, cn, cn_x2); try T55's direction record (part_read.all_directions) covers all five of its forms and is recorded whole, so that it can be compared with try T55's lib3 file by part_read.direction_values (every form's sha256, a_n and a_p per group).

'Stays positive' uses the difference's mean (above zero) and seeds ahead (strictly above zero, at least 8) as tries T46 to T55 count them; 'behind' is try T46's label (the reversed single-task test: a mean below -0.3 with at least 8 of 10 seeds behind), which the amendment's 'at most 2 of 10 seeds ahead' equals only when no seed ties; the amendment's statement drops the brief's second turn condition (a negative mean with at most 2 seeds ahead, level by the test).

A difference behind in one draw of a world with a second draw (and not in the other) is not a turn and is named under 'not separated'; a draw where that difference stays positive is not named. 'It turns' wins over 'not separated' when both apply, and the differences meeting neither are still recorded.
The side of lib3 is try T50's ('truth shallower than the reference'), as for every try T50 world.

Each file must hold its own world's name, the chamber cut and its truth (the world's name for try T50's worlds, lib3 for try T54's), and lib3 must record no thinning: the same file checks tries T50 and T54 make.

The truth's row and contamination checks are try T50's own (over_read._sizes_agree: each thinned truth's counts equal lib3's), run on the T50 worlds only; try T54's worlds, whose truth is lib3 as released, are not checked against lib3's counts, since neither try makes that check.

The two draws side by side and libraries 1 and 2 from try T55's committed files are computed with try T50's comparison (over_read.comparison); a library file that is missing or lacks a seed or an arm is printed as not available and voids nothing.
limits: Each difference is taken inside one world, in that world's own points, and is not compared across worlds.
A thinned truth or reference is one draw for all seeds, which the paired difference inside a world shares between its two arms.
A thinned reference also changes the floor, the de terms' reference, B0's shift and g_mom's fit.
'Stays positive at every depth read' covers truths 0.3 to 1.8 times as deep as the reference and no other.
One released day, in-sample, the chamber cut and one library only.
Equal movement is equal squared size of the direction, not equal counts moved.
The released day's low share along the group-specific parts may be that day's pace and says nothing about the two days of the test.
Nothing here says how deep any hidden truth is, and no statement may be used with a figure for it.
lib3 reproduces try T55's committed scores by rule and adds no evidence: the statement rests on the six thinned worlds, all made from the one library where the form was ahead at both fractions.
'Stays positive' says nothing about size: a gain that falls to a few hundredths still stays positive, and each mean is printed.
'It turns' is a difference behind by 0.3 in a world's own points, which a rescaled floor and ceiling can produce with no raw metric changing sign, so it is read beside the raw-metric differences.
Try T50's worlds change the truth only and try T54's change the inputs, the floor, the de terms' reference, B0's shift and g_mom's fit: two manipulations, not one axis.

reading.outcome: the common part's gain at equal movement stays positive at every depth read

statement.statement: the common part's gain at equal movement stays positive at every depth read
